allowed.rationale: First-party read-only Brazilian electoral data MCP server (TSE Resultados EA20 & Dados Abertos CKAN) with Zod .strict() runtime input validation and host-allowlisted HTTPS upstream connectors

entries.name: tse_eleicoes_catalogo

entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TseEleicoesCatalogoSchema.strict() with bounded limit (1..50).

entries.name: tse_municipios_zonas

entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TseMunicipiosZonasSchema.strict() requiring >=1 filter and bounded limit (1..50).

entries.name: tse_apuracao_cargo
entries.description: Query EA20 section tally, turnout summary, and paginated candidate vote rankings for an electoral office.
entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TseApuracaoCargoSchema.strict() with cargo/scope validation, bounded page/limit, and LGPD Art. 20 homonym notice.

entries.name: tse_candidatos_busca
entries.description: Search EA20 candidates (including running mates/substitutes) by name, number, party, or elected status.
entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TseCandidatosBuscaSchema.strict() with bounded limit (1..50), sanitized untrusted text, and LGPD Art. 20 notice.

entries.name: tse_partidos_federacoes
entries.description: Summarize party and federation nominal/legend vote totals and elected counts from EA20 -u.json.
entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TsePartidosFederacoesSchema.strict() with cargo/scope validation and bounded limit (1..50).

entries.description: Fetch EA20 turnout, abstention, eligible voters, and polling section stats by Brazil, UF, or municipality.
entries.rationale: Read-only allowlisted-HTTPS lookup validated by TseComparecimentoAbstencaoSchema.strict() enforcing 2-letter UF when municipal code is supplied.
